High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is sixth repeat application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.275/2020 registered at Police Station Gohad, District Bhind (M.P.)
for the offences punishable under Sections 304B,498A IPC and under Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant, after arguing for a while, seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the present application.
Accordingly, instant M.Cr.C. stands dismissed as withdrawn.
